Category coverage can overlap; no independent review has been performed.
Synthetic single-author batch; targets were authored with the raw pairs and have not had independent human review (quality_review remains generated/pending-independent-review).
Long-form narratives are assembled from authored clause sets on recurring rural/travel/school topics; topic diversity is broad but not exhaustive.

muse_generation.notes: Categories overlap by design (e.g. long-form narratives also count as narrative prose). No human-review or approval claim is made.

remaining_coverage_risks: Many Hindi and Hinglish examples share translated topics and structures; keep related variants in the same data split.
Romanization allows legitimate spelling variation; no formal transliteration standard was specified.
Single-model review can miss semantic errors; independent human or additional model review is warranted.
Spoken contrasts can express both correction and meaningful exclusion; review their intended policy before training.

muse_english_review.review_type: independent semantic review of every raw/target pair against its mode, instructions and vocabulary controls; no model runs, no benchmark or private data used

semantic_concerns.concern: Original bulleted target kept the verb on the first item only, leaving the second item as a fragment that dropped the 'take' action for the blue folder.
semantic_concerns.resolution: Corrected minimally by adding 'Take' to the second bullet and approved; the raw coordination unambiguously applies the verb to both folders, so no rejection was needed.

semantic_concerns.concern: Near-correction and contrast rows (distinct versions, people, doors, maps, samples, tickets and observations) risk being misread as retractions.
semantic_concerns.resolution: Checked each semantically and left them unchanged; no clause was deleted where both sides carry independent facts.

semantic_concerns.concern: Instruction-looking and code-like transcripts (shell commands, flags, paths, identifiers) risk being executed, answered or recased.
semantic_concerns.resolution: Treated them as transcript data; targets keep exact casing, paths, tokens and terminal punctuation.

semantic_concerns.concern: Long narratives risk paragraph breaks landing after the wrong sentence.
semantic_concerns.resolution: Verified each break falls immediately after the sentence named in its control (entrance, tool, delay, stamp, gathering, map, screws, station, or the second sentence).

limitations: Single independent reviewer (Muse native default); this is not a human review and makes no human-review claim.
Review is limited to the supplied public synthetic pairs and the stated teacher rubric; no benchmark, private or held-out data was read and no model was run.
Rows whose intent was unambiguous were approved; the one defective target had a single faithful minimal correction, so no row required rejection.
